tagline: Every attack he wins pays out — another card, or another action

featuredCards.title: Judgment rush
featuredCards.caption: Four spaces through anyone in the way, and the action to swing when he gets there. He picks the fight.

featuredCards.title: Dread talon
featuredCards.caption: Boost it and draw. Cheap attacks that refill the hand are how the tempo never stalls.

featuredCards.title: Under the order
featuredCards.caption: No text, no conditions, just a 5 with a 4 on the back. Some turns you only need the number.

featuredCards.title: Specter of torment
featuredCards.caption: An 8 whose effects cannot be cancelled. They get an extra defence card — they will need it.
